sufficient_sets.text: Borneo () is the third-largest island in the world, with an area of 748168 km2, and population of 23,053,723 (2020 national censuses).
Java is the world's most populous island, home to an estimated 159.2 million people; about 56% of the Indonesian population, while constituting only 7% of the country's land area.
